tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Goods and Services Tax (GST) was implemented w.e.f. 01st July 2017 and as per the FAQs on Government Services issued by CBIC, GST is payable on Royalty paid for assignment of right to use natural resources. However, Company contends that GST is not payable on Royalty paid under the Oil Fields (Regulation & Development) Act, 1948. The Company has accordingly filed a writ petition in Hon'ble Gauhati High Court challenging such a levy. Further, the Hon’ble Gauhati High Court, vide its interim order dated 2nd November 2021 has granted stay on the GST on royalty payments made by the Company in the state of Assam until further orders.
tax_litigation.status: same as reported in last quarter

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: State of Assam amended the Assam Taxation (on Specified Lands) Act, 1990 (“the Principal Act”) vide the Assam Taxation (on Specified Lands) (Amendment) Act, 2004. As per the said Amendment Act, an oil producer is required to pay, in the case of Crude Oil, Rs. 200/- per metric ton and in the case of Natural Gas, Rs. 100/- per thousand cubic meters of annual productivity of the land. Accordingly, the Government of Assam has raised a demand of approx. Rs. 2484.81 crores for the years 2005-2024 under the impugned Amendment Act, which has been challenged by OIL as it is ultra vires of the Constitution of India.
tax_litigation.status: same as reported in last quarter

operating_notes.text: OIL Green Energy Limited entered an MoU with Numaligarh Refinery Limited on April 20, 2026, for renewable energy supply and group captive requirements.
Fifth hydrocarbon discovery in Libyan Block 95/96, operated by SIPEX, with OIL holding 25% participating interest
Oil India reported a gas discovery in the Dandewala Field in Rajasthan with an average inflow of 25,000 SCMD and estimated Gas In Place of 75 MMSCM.
FY26 annual production stood at 6.36 MMTOE (3.18 MMTOE oil, 3.18 MMTOE natural gas), with 0.33 MMTOE lost due to shutdowns and a Q3FY26 blockade.
Total 2P reserves stood at 231 MMTOE in FY26 with domestic reserve replacement ratio of 1.02.
OIL Green Energy Ltd. signed a 50:50 JV agreement with Hindustan Waste Treatment Pvt. Ltd. for bioenergy and waste management.
FY26 drilling reached a record 74 wells, including 22 exploratory and 52 development wells.
Oil India reported presence of natural gas in its 3rd exploratory well Vijayapuram-3 in Andaman Shallow Offshore Block AN-OSHP-2018/1.
Crude realisation USD98.73/bbl vs USD66.20 YoY; gas realisation USD7.19/MMBtu vs USD6.72.
NRL capacity utilisation 105%, distillate yield 87%, GRM USD35.95/bbl (USD5.02 YoY).
Group debt ₹37,233 Cr: NRL ₹19,000 Cr, Mozambique USD1.4 bn loan, Singapore USD500 mn bond due May 2027.
Signed RSC for Special CBM Block SR-ONHP-(CBM)-2026/1 covering 272.14 sq. km in the Singrauli Coalfield, with expected coal seam depths of 600-800 m.
Discovered natural gas in the Matsyapuri formation in shallow offshore block KG-DSF/GSKW/2018 in the Krishna-Godavari Basin with gas flow of 1-2 lakh SCUMD.

timeline.summary: OIL Green Energy signed an MoU with Numaligarh Refinery on April 20, 2026, for renewable energy collaboration.
2026-04-27: Oil India Limited announces fifth hydrocarbon discovery in Libyan Block 95/96
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹10,012.77 Cr (+4.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹2,099.61 Cr (+60.3% YoY).
Oil India Limited’s Board, led by **Ajaya Kumar Sahoo**, recommended a ₹1 final dividend per share (10% of paid-up capital) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval.
Oil India announced a natural gas discovery in the Dandewala field in Rajasthan with an inflow of 25,000 SCMD.
Oil India presented FY26 highlights and strategic roadmap targeting 10-12 MMTOE production by FY30, 100 wells in FY27, and 9 MMTPA NRL refining expansion.
Oil India Limited uploaded the video recording of its Investors’ and Analysts’ Meet on 25.05.2026, confirming no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared.
OIL Green Energy signed a JV agreement with Hindustan Waste Treatment for bioenergy and waste management projects.
Oil India disclosed fines of ₹5.50 lakh each from NSE and BSE for non-compliance with board composition rules for the quarter ended March 2026.
Oil India hosted its annual analysts' meet on May 25, 2026, highlighting record drilling, steady production, and progress on the NRL expansion.
Oil India reported the presence of natural gas in its 3rd exploratory well Vijayapuram-3 in the Andaman Shallow Offshore Block.
Oil India's subsidiary OIL Green Energy incorporated a 50% joint venture named Hind Oil Biofuels with a ₹5 lakh subscription.
Oil India signed the Revenue Sharing Contract on 15-10-2026 for Special CBM Block SR-ONHP-(CBM)-2026/1, spanning 272.14 sq. km in the Singrauli Coalfield, marking its return to CBM exploration.
Oil India announced a natural gas discovery in the Matsyapuri formation of shallow offshore block KG-DSF/GSKW/2018 in the Krishna-Godavari Basin.
